description: This file defines the UriComposer class, which implements the IUriComposer interface to generate URIs based on a template and catalog settings. It primarily contains a constructor and a method to compose picture URIs.

classes.name: UriComposer
classes.description: A service class responsible for composing URIs for catalog items based on provided settings.

methods.name: UriComposer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the UriComposer with catalog settings.

methods.name: ComposePicUri
methods.description: Replaces the placeholder in the URI template with the actual catalog base URL from settings.
